name: Silverwind Refuge
summary: Sentinels guard Silverwind Refuge in south-central Ashenvale, just north of Mystral Lake. Travelers find shelter along the forest trails.

sections.title: A Forest Sanctuary
sections.body: Silverwind Refuge lies between Mystral Lake and Iris Lake, with Iris Lake to the north. Alongside Astranaar, it is one of central Ashenvale’s chief night elven waystations. Craftsmen and wilderness trainers teach herbalism, alchemy, skinning, and hunting. Sentinels guard the refuge, where allies crossing the ancient woods can rest.

faq.answer: The night elves built and maintain Silverwind Refuge as an Alliance settlement. Sentinels guard its grounds.
Silverwind Refuge lies in south-central Ashenvale, directly north of Mystral Lake and south of Iris Lake.

faq.q: What services are found at the refuge?
faq.answer: Travelers can find trade supply vendors and trainers who teach herbalism, alchemy, skinning, and hunter skills.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler crossing Ashenvale, you can rest at Silverwind Refuge, replenish supplies, and improve your wilderness trades without traveling all the way to Astranaar.
As an herbalist, you can train at Silverwind Refuge, a useful stop among the plants around Mystral Lake.
